protocol:
Quick Protocol for Monarch® PCR & DNA Cleanup Kit (5 μg) (NEB #T1030)
Dilute sample with DNA Cleanup Binding Buffer according to the table below.
Mix well by pipetting up and down or flicking the tube.
Do not vortex.
A sample volume of 20–100 μl is recommended.
For smaller samples, TE can be used to adjust the volume.
For diluted samples larger than 800 μl, load a portion of the sample, proceed with step 2, and then repeat as necessary.
Sample TypeRatio of Binding Buffer: 
SampleExampledsDNA > 2 kb (plasmids, gDNA)2:1200 μl: 100 μldsDNA < 2 kb (some amplicons,  fragments)5:1500 μl: 100 μlssDNA (cDNA, M13)7:1700 μl: 100 μl. 
Insert column into collection tube and load sample onto column.
Spin for 1 minute at 16,000 x g, then discard flow-through.
Re-insert column into collection tube.
Add 200 μl DNA Wash Buffer (with ethanol added) and spin for 1 minute at 16,000 x g. 
Discarding flow-through is optional.
Repeat Step 3.
(Step 3: Re-insert column into collection tube.
Add 200 μl DNA Wash Buffer and spin for 1 minute at 16,000 x g. 
Discarding flow-through is optional).
Transfer column to a clean 1.5 ml microfuge tube.
Use care to ensure that the tip of the column does not come into contact with the flow-through.
If in doubt, re-spin for 1 minute.
Add ≥ 6 μl of DNA Elution Buffer to the center of the matrix.
Wait for 1 minute, then spin for 1 minute at 16,000 x g to elute the DNA.

parameters.volume: variable (see table, e.g., 200 μl, 500 μl, 700 μl)

parameters.container: column to clean 1.5 ml microfuge tube

script:
# Lab Automation Script
# Generated from protocol analysis


### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
dilute(container='tube', reagent='DNA Cleanup Binding Buffer', volume='variable (see table, e.g., 200 μl, 500 μl, 700 μl)', sample_volume='20–100 μl recommended', sample_type='dsDNA > 2 kb, dsDNA < 2 kb, ssDNA', ratio='2:1, 5:1, 7:1')
mix(container='tube', reagent='diluted sample', volume='total sample volume', method='pipetting up and down')
adjust(container='tube', reagent='TE', volume='variable (to reach recommended sample volume)', condition='for smaller samples')
load(container='column in collection tube', reagent='diluted sample', volume='≤ 800 μl per load', repeat='if sample > 800 μl, repeat loading')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: insert (container: column into collection tube, other: {})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
centrifuge(container='collection tube with column', reagent='sample', duration='1 minute', speed='16,000 x g')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: discard (container: collection tube, reagent: flow-through, other: {})
# MANUAL: insert (container: column into collection tube, other: {})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
add(container='column in collection tube', reagent='DNA Wash Buffer (with ethanol added)', volume='200 μl')
centrifuge(container='collection tube with column', reagent='DNA Wash Buffer', duration='1 minute', speed='16,000 x g')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: discard (container: collection tube, reagent: flow-through, other: {'optional': True})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
repeat(container='collection tube with column', reagent='DNA Wash Buffer', volume='200 μl', duration='1 minute', speed='16,000 x g', step='add wash buffer and centrifuge')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: transfer (container: column to clean 1.5 ml microfuge tube, other: {})

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
add(container='column (in clean 1.5 ml microfuge tube)', reagent='DNA Elution Buffer', volume='≥ 6 μl', location='center of the matrix')
wait(container='column in microfuge tube', duration='1 minute')
centrifuge(container='microfuge tube with column', reagent='elution buffer', duration='1 minute', speed='16,000 x g', purpose='elute DNA')
